newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile Jan-May copper output up 14 pct on 1996.
newsitem.headline: Chile Jan-May copper output up 14 pct on 1996.

text.p: Chilean copper production totalled 1.39 million tonnes in the first five months of the year, up 14 percent on the same period last year, said state copper studies center Comision Chilena del Cobre.
The sharpest increase was reported in production of electro-won cathodes which climbed 54 percent over the last year to 345,300 tonnes.
The figures showed production of copper in concentrates rising 6.3 percent to 491,800 tonnes.
Fire-refined copper production increased 4.8 percent to 461,400 pesos, while blister output fell 3.4 percent to 87,100 tonnes.
Molybdenum output rose 24.6 percent to 8,554 tonnes.
